title: Athens War Museum
scope: The standing War Museum at the corner of Vasilissis Sofias and Rizari, including its glazed lower floor, deep overhanging upper gallery, public entry terrace and open central atrium.
limitations: The outer footprint and central atrium follow the native mapped outlines. The undimensioned vertical section, canopy batter, lower window divisions and plaza approach are approximate.
The modeled extent includes the standing museum and its entry terrace. The yard exhibits, artwork, interior displays, and neighboring Byzantine and Christian Museum are outside its scope.
